image.head: Generate a still IMAGE (a single photograph, not a video). One single picture, not a collage, grid or split frame:
image.realism: Realistic spring landscape photograph, looks like a real place shot on a full-frame camera with a {lens}, true-to-life materials and textures, accurate real-world scale and proportions, natural color grading.

look.interior-bright: Bright natural daylight with lifted shadows and clear detail, never murky or crushed.
look.day: Soft fresh daylight under a natural sky, balanced exposure with clean highlights and gentle shadows.
look.soft-morning: Quiet morning light through young leaves, pale warmth, soft contrast and a calm airy atmosphere.
look.golden: Low warm golden-hour light with long soft shadows, fresh greens and restrained highlights.
look.overcast: Bright spring overcast, soft shadow edges, moist natural surfaces and gentle true-to-life colors.
look.after-rain: Fresh light after rain, damp leaves and stones, delicate reflections and clean air without a dramatic storm sky.

image.lights: Natural light only: believable daylight, soft sky light and restrained reflections; no artificial glow, fantasy beams or floating sparkles.
image.motion_ready: Clear foreground, middle ground and background layers, with {motion_elements} clearly visible and physically plausible.
image.clean: The place is unoccupied: no people, human figures or silhouettes, no animals, birds, vehicles, signs, text, numbers, logos or brand marks; leaves, flowers, water and branches have believable real-world geometry.
image.tail: Sharp focus, a single 16:9 landscape photograph, clean edges and natural photographic depth.
